prayerExcerpt.en-US: St. Leander was no less zealous in the reformation of manners than in restoring the purity of faith.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: São Leandro não foi menos zeloso na reforma dos costumes do que em restaurar a pureza da fé.

meta.face: A Hispano-Roman of about sixty with a pale, sallow olive complexion and a LEAN, LONG face — a high, narrow forehead with the dark hair RECEDING, deep-set, heavy-lidded black eyes under STRONG, ARCHED black brows, a long, straight nose with a slight HUMP at the bridge, flat, lean cheeks, a thin, firm mouth, and a NARROW, POINTED chin; a SHORT, close-trimmed black beard and moustache flecked with grey; the gaze searching and serious, turned a little aside.
meta.basis: Murillo's San Leandro (1655, Seville Cathedral; Wikipedia lead image, Commons page consulted) shows a lean, dark, short-bearded face under a white mitre, holding a written sheet against the Arians; tradition, per Commons, says the face was taken from the licenciate Alonso de Herrera. The card follows the painting without its words. The book's engraving shows him bearded with mitre and crozier by him, beside a youth writing.
